access.account_hacked_or_locked.title: Account blocked, hacked, or wrongly locked out
access.account_hacked_or_locked.description: Users report accounts being blocked, accessed by unknown logins, or having playlists and data removed.

access.logged_out.title: Unexpectedly logged out and losing library
access.logged_out.description: Users are logged out after updates or randomly, then cannot log back in and sometimes lose playlists or premium status.

access.login_failure.title: Cannot sign in to the app
access.login_failure.description: Users repeatedly fail to sign in, including through Google or Facebook, and get stuck in login loops or error messages.

access.other.title: Miscellaneous access, region, and compatibility problems
access.other.description: Users report trouble changing country or username, offline errors, download failures, and device incompatibility messages.
access.other.suggested_split: Region/country and username changes; device compatibility and install failures;

access.password_reset.title: Password reset emails and recovery fail
access.password_reset.description: Users forgot passwords and struggle with reset emails that never arrive or cannot be used on their device.

access.signup.title: Cannot create a new account
access.signup.description: Users cannot sign up, do not receive OTP codes, or face long, looping account creation flows.

billing.cancel_or_refund.title: Difficult to cancel subscription
billing.cancel_or_refund.description: Users find cancellation blocked or buried, with repeated confirmations and retention pressure, and some report unwanted charges.
billing.cancel_or_refund.suggested_split: Cancellation friction versus charges and debit orders; complaints about content

billing.other.title: Billing, gift card, and subscription complaints
billing.other.description: Users report invalid gift cards, inability to change billing dates, and general dissatisfaction with premium value.
billing.other.suggested_split: Gift cards and billing date changes; free trial and general premium value

billing.plans_family_student.title: Plan tiers and premium value concerns
billing.plans_family_student.description: Users feel premium is not worth it, lack regional features, or object to group and multi-membership plan limits.

billing.premium_only_controls.title: Basic playback controls locked behind premium
billing.premium_only_controls.description: Users say features like repeating songs, playing specific song sections, and ordered playback now require a paid subscription.

billing.price.title: Premium subscription price considered too high
billing.price.description: Users feel the subscription costs too much for what they receive, including more ads and removed bundled benefits.

billing.subscription_activation.title: Unable to purchase or activate premium subscription
billing.subscription_activation.description: Users cannot complete premium purchases in the app, often due to payment methods being rejected or premium not activating after payment.

billing.unexpected_charges.title: Charged after cancelling or without subscribing
billing.unexpected_charges.description: Users report recurring or duplicate charges continuing after cancellation, uninstalling, or for services they never signed up for.

catalog.lyrics.title: Lyrics fail to load or display
catalog.lyrics.description: Users report that lyrics do not load, do not appear for some songs, or appear in the wrong language.

catalog.missing_or_removed_content.title: Songs missing or removed from catalog
catalog.missing_or_removed_content.description: Users say songs they expect, including regional and Bollywood tracks, are unavailable or were removed.

catalog.other.title: Miscellaneous song and content complaints
catalog.other.description: A mixed group of complaints about playlist song mixing, inappropriate content, and limited song selection.
catalog.other.suggested_split: Inappropriate or explicit content; Wrong or mixed songs playing

catalog.podcasts_audiobooks.title: Podcasts unavailable, missing, or unsearchable
catalog.podcasts_audiobooks.description: Users cannot find, play, or search podcasts, and some podcast episodes or history are missing or hidden.

catalog.recommendations.title: Unwanted or repetitive algorithmic recommendations
catalog.recommendations.description: Users dislike auto-generated playlists and suggestions that play unrelated songs, repeat tracks, or ignore their requests.

catalog.search.title: Search fails or returns wrong songs
catalog.search.description: Users struggle to find desired songs, and search returns other tracks or errors instead of the requested one.

downloads.download_failure.title: Songs and podcasts fail to download
downloads.download_failure.description: Users cannot download music or podcasts for offline listening, are prompted for premium, or experience slow downloads.

downloads.downloads_disappear.title: Downloaded songs vanish or reset unexpectedly
downloads.downloads_disappear.description: Users report downloaded songs, playlists, and liked songs disappearing from the device, often requiring a re-download.

downloads.offline_mode.title: Downloaded music won't play offline
downloads.offline_mode.description: Users say songs they downloaded do not play without internet, or the app shows offline status incorrectly after connecting.

downloads.other.title: Downloads and playlists missing or not working
downloads.other.description: Users report downloaded playlists or liked songs not showing in the library, downloading failing, or downloading restricted to premium.
downloads.other.suggested_split: Downloaded content not visible in library; downloading restricted or failing

downloads.storage.title: App takes too much storage and misuses SD card
downloads.storage.description: Users complain the app consumes a large amount of device space and downloads go to internal storage instead of the chosen SD card.
downloads.storage.suggested_split: SD card storage location not respected; app storage footprint too large

other.boycott_political.title: Users boycott app over political controversy
other.boycott_political.description: Reviews call for boycotts or uninstalling due to political or religious controversies tied to the company or its country.

other.general_criticism.title: Generic negative sentiment without specifics
other.general_criticism.description: Reviews express general dissatisfaction or hatred toward the app without naming a specific product problem.

other.general_praise.title: Positive feedback with wish for artist pay
other.general_praise.description: Reviewers praise the app while wishing artists were paid more or noting they switched to another service.
other.general_praise.suggested_split: Requests for higher artist payments; general positive feedback

other.other.title: Frustration with recent app update
other.other.description: Users say a recent update made the app worse, want features rolled back, or cannot find features like Wrapped.
other.other.suggested_split: Recent update made app worse; Spotify Wrapped not visible

other.unrelated_or_unintelligible.title: Unrelated, unintelligible, or off-topic comments
other.unrelated_or_unintelligible.description: Reviews are off-topic, unintelligible, or mention unrelated subjects such as Wrapped access or advertising.
other.unrelated_or_unintelligible.suggested_split: Spotify Wrapped not visible; advertising complaints

playback.audio_quality.title: Poor audio quality with noise and dropouts
playback.audio_quality.description: Users report crackling, popping, low volume, echo, or missing audio during playback.

playback.background_play.title: App stops or misbehaves in background playback
playback.background_play.description: Users report music stopping, crashing, or auto-starting when the app runs in the background or when other apps and notifications are used.

playback.battery_resource_use.title: App drains battery and uses excessive resources
playback.battery_resource_use.description: Users say Spotify keeps running in the background, cannot be closed or hibernated, and consumes battery and RAM heavily.

playback.connection_errors.title: False 'no internet connection' errors while online
playback.connection_errors.description: Users see 'No internet connection' or offline status even when connected to working Wi-Fi or data.

playback.crashes_or_wont_open.title: App crashes or fails to open after updates
playback.crashes_or_wont_open.description: Users report the app crashing constantly, closing during playback, or refusing to load until reinstalled.

playback.device_connectivity.title: Problems playing through Bluetooth, speakers, and watches
playback.device_connectivity.description: Users report playback failing or misbehaving with Bluetooth headphones, smart speakers, vehicles, and wearables.

playback.lag_or_slow.title: App is slow to respond and load content
playback.lag_or_slow.description: Users say the app lags, takes minutes to load songs or playlists, and responds slowly to input.

playback.other.title: Wrong songs play or features fail to work
playback.other.description: Users report pressing a song plays a different one, shuffle ignores playlist order, video podcasts won't play, and sharing shows errors.
playback.other.suggested_split: Wrong track selection in playlists; Video podcast and sharing failures

playback.stops_or_skips.title: Music stops, skips, or cuts out mid-song
playback.stops_or_skips.description: Users report songs skipping, audio cutting out, or playback stopping after short periods.

support.contact_difficulty.title: No accessible customer support or phone contact
support.contact_difficulty.description: Users say Spotify offers no phone or live support and that getting problems resolved or cancelling subscriptions is difficult.

support.no_response.title: Support requests and reviews go unanswered
support.no_response.description: Users say Spotify does not reply to support emails, queries, or reviews.

support.other.title: Poor customer support experience overall
support.other.description: Users report bad support experiences, unwanted harassment after cancelling, and support favoring paying customers.

support.unhelpful_response.title: Support gives unhelpful, repetitive, or no resolution
support.unhelpful_response.description: Users say support replies with scripted or repeated messages, promises fixes that never arrive, or redirects them without solving their problem.

usability.ads.title: Too many ads interrupting listening
usability.ads.description: Users complain that ads are frequent and intrusive, often outnumbering the music they hear.

usability.controls.title: Playback controls removed or unreliable
usability.controls.description: Users report missing or broken controls such as loop, skip, rewind, like, and song selection.

usability.navigation_layout.title: Confusing navigation and cluttered interface layout
usability.navigation_layout.description: Users find the interface hard to navigate, with difficulty locating features, sorting options, and albums.

usability.other.title: Miscellaneous usability and performance complaints
usability.other.description: A mix of complaints including freezing, lack of a light theme, slowness, search behavior, and rating prompts.
usability.other.suggested_split: App freezing and performance; Missing dark or light theme option

usability.queue_playlist_management.title: Unwanted songs added to playlists and queue
usability.queue_playlist_management.description: Users say the app inserts songs into their playlists or plays tracks outside their playlist without consent, and they cannot remove them.

usability.redesign_update.title: Recent update made app worse
usability.redesign_update.description: Users say a recent redesign or update removed features, hid content, and made the app harder to use.

usability.shuffle_autoplay.title: Shuffle forced; cannot play songs in order
usability.shuffle_autoplay.description: Users cannot choose specific songs or play in order because shuffle is forced and tracks repeat.

usability.widgets_notifications_lockscre.title: Widgets, notifications, and lock-screen controls problematic
usability.widgets_notifications_lockscre.description: Users report widget clutter, undismissable notifications, duplicate player overlays, and playback starting unexpectedly from car connections.
usability.widgets_notifications_lockscre.suggested_split: Notification and widget settings; Unwanted auto-play on device connection
